installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Server files are installed into the volume mounted at /mnt/server.
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
curl --fail --location --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 --silent --show-error --output steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar --extract --gzip --file steamcmd.tar.gz --directory /mnt/server/steamcmd --no-same-owner
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD needs a writable HOME and an existing steamapps directory.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +login anonymous +app_update "${SRCDS_APPID}" validate +quit

# Fail installation if SteamCMD returned without the native server payload.
test -x /mnt/server/srcds_run
test -x /mnt/server/srcds_linux
test -f /mnt/server/dod/gameinfo.txt

# Make the Steam client libraries available at the locations expected by SRCDS.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# Seed the file parser targets without overwriting an operator's existing config.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/dod/cfg
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/dod/cfg/server.cfg ]; then
    cat <<'EOF' > /mnt/server/dod/cfg/server.cfg
hostname "A Pterodactyl Hosted Day of Defeat: Source Server"
sv_password ""
rcon_password ""
sv_lan 0
EOF
fi

echo "Installation completed successfully."

variables.default_value: A Pterodactyl Hosted Day of Defeat: Source Server

variables.name: Default Map
variables.description: The map loaded when the server starts, for example dod_anzio or dod_avalanche.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum number of players allowed on the server.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password required to join the server. Leave blank for public access.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password used for remote console administration. Leave blank to disable RCON authentication.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically update the server through SteamCMD each time the container starts.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Internal Steam identifier used to install and update the dedicated server. Do not change.

variables.name: Game Folder
variables.description: Internal Source engine game folder used to launch the server. Do not change.
